citations.revision_finding: The functionality's own footnote on step 4(c) records that this provision was MISSING from reference [25], which is this paper's CRYPTO 2022 proceedings version. Transcribed as line 47. A protocol proved against the proceedings text is not proved against this box: without it, post-compromise security heals in two epochs; with it, an adversary can postpone healing without bound by delivering unclaimed epoch ids.
citations.defect_finding: rcv_msgnum is initialized in both of F_SM's initialization paths and read in Corrupt (under the different name 'received msg num'), and is incremented nowhere in the functionality. Checked across the whole paper: 8 occurrences, of which 2 are the initializations, 1 the read, and 5 belong to Pi_SGNL, a different object that does maintain it. Transcribed as printed (line 69) rather than repaired, because repairing it means choosing where the increment goes and the source does not say.
